text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We said our prayers properly!
Thank you for accompanying me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: With this, the slump should be blown away... Huh?

E-Even I can pull
Great Fortune on my first try...!

I'll make her realize that
my luck isn't going to lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Good day♪
Are you aiming for Great Blessing?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
K-Kawakami-san!?
Did you hear that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "N-N-No! It's not like I'm trying to compete with her or anything...!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it wonderful♪
If you're aiming for something, aim for the top! If you're drawing a fortune, make it Great Blessing!
Aiming high is what life's all about!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I shall cheer you on with my Princess 100-Shrine Pilgrimage!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I saw that on Precure when I was little.
If I remember right, the princess was cheering on her underclassman's dream...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're actually going to do that?
For my sake...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Now that you're feeling better,
this should be a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Doryaaaaaaaah~~!!
One! ...Two! ...Threeee!
Kawakami Princess began sprinting back and forth between the torii gate and the main shrine. Almost like a shuttle run...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Kawakami-san... Putting everything she has into this...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm always encouraged
by that powerful running style...
I need to pull myself together too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"May Scarlet-san pull an undeniable
Great Blessing fortuneーーーーー!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Scarlet!
Why did you do that!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "...It's a Great Blessing!! It really was!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, babyyyyy!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thank you so much!
It's all thanks to Kawakami-san giving me courage.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you were the one who pulled it yourself!
I only helped a tiny bit♪

Kawakami Princess looked delighted by her junior's smile.
It seemed she had completely bounced back from her slump!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: T-The thing is... the fortune box was completely empty...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what...!?
I cannot be of any help like this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! Kawakami-san's running gave me
so much encouragement,
so next time, I'll draw it with my own strength!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Scarlet-san...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... what a sweet child.
I wanted to give her a spirited boost...
Kawakami Princess looked dejected. It seemed she hadn't recovered her form just yet...
